entries.2759b8d223ea03ae: This is a single-segment business that establishes, operates and manages paid nursing homes for the elderly and serviced housing for the elderly in Hokkaido. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,036 million. As of the end of the fiscal year, the company operates 6 nursing care paid nursing homes, 2 residential-type paid nursing homes, 1 general residence, 1 day service facility, and 2 serviced housing facilities for the elderly in Sapporo.

entries.834a0d64fbd5d7ab: A company that operates fee-based nursing homes with care services and senior housing with support services in Hokkaido, providing housing and nursing care services to elderly people.

entries.d22a0b03e109870c: The company operates two facilities in Sapporo: Varus Cuore Sapporo Kita and Varus Cuore Minami 19-jo 2. These are residential facilities with living support services, and residents who require care may choose to receive care services from external providers and live independently. The land and buildings are leased.
entries.da7718fa9d39fca9: Elderly people receiving care at home and their families
entries.decc49ae2d274ce2: The company operates Varus Cuore Otaru in Otaru City and Masters Varus Hokkaido Ballpark, which opened in June 2024 within the Hokkaido Ballpark F Village in Kitahiroshima City. It provides living support services, meal services and care services, and the land and buildings are leased. Varus Cuore Otaru is designated as a specified facility for resident living care (preventive care).
entries.e5313425bd483c89: At Sapporo Minami Day Service Center in Minami-ku, Sapporo, the company provides day care services and first-category day service business, offering bathing, daily motion training, recreation and other services. The service started in July 2016.
